title: Phase 6.2.41 — Evidence Recovery Impact Measurement Report

verdict_constraints.disclaimer: EVIDENCE_RECOVERY_MEASURED confirms empirical measurement of evidence recovery yields. It does NOT authorize production promotion, lifecycle updates, or user testing.

recovery_matrix.main_failure_reason: Multi-blocker coupling: 728 recovered units remain in HOLD due to persistent semantic or Thai deficits.
Inventory limitation: 5,074 units absent from repo 93-sentence subset (TRUE_SOURCE_GAP), plus secondary semantic gaps.
TRUE_SOURCE_GAP: 100% of candidate lemmas (modern tech, compounds, C1/C2 derivatives) are missing from 2003 LEXiTRON.
Multi-blocker dead ends: 3,167 units with resolved semantics remain trapped in HOLD due to missing example sentences.
Multi-blocker dead ends: 615 units (98.72%) simultaneously suffer from missing examples or semantic deficits.

largest_recoverable_population.intervention: OEWN semantic evidence (definitions, synset members, relations, glosses)
largest_recoverable_population.finding: Highest measured absolute recovery yield among all single-source interventions (+415 AUTO_CANDIDATE, 834 moved out of HOLD).

largest_population_low_recovery_yield.intervention: OEWN example recovery & Tatoeba example recovery
largest_population_low_recovery_yield.finding: Despite affecting 5,308 units (54.84% of blocked population), example recovery achieves only 1.94% (OEWN) and 0.26% (Tatoeba) conversion to AUTO_CANDIDATE because 728 recovered units remain held by secondary semantic deficits.

most_multi_blocker_dead_ends.finding: Exactly 3,001 units suffer from both missing examples AND zero semantic definition overlap. Neither example expansion alone nor semantic expansion alone can unlock these units past HOLD.

currently_preventing_otherwise_strong_un.finding: 365 units are blocked ONLY by EXAMPLE_NOT_FOUND, 1,136 units ONLY by SEMANTIC_NO_EVIDENCE, 1,146 units ONLY by POLYSEMY_UNRESOLVED, and 8 units ONLY by IPA. These 2,655 units are otherwise fully compliant across all other gates.

projection_policy.reason: Cross-dependent multi-blocker coupling (69.82% of blocked units) prevents linear extrapolation. No single source intervention can unlock thousands of units in isolation.

recommended_next_intervention.track_1: OEWN Definition & Relation Gloss Expansion: Directly addresses the largest recoverable bottleneck (4,001 units, +415 AUTO_CANDIDATE).
recommended_next_intervention.track_2: Full Tatoeba Sentence Corpus Ingestion with Strict POS Gating: Directly addresses the 365 sole-blocker units and unlocks the 3,001 co-dependent units when paired with Track 1.
